business_summary: Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited provides healthcare services in China. It operates hospitals and medical centers. The company also engages in insurance broking, E-commerce, health and asset management, tourism, professional design, technological development, food and beverages, and pharmaceutical production business. The company was formerly known as Xi'an Kaiyuan Investment Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited in January 2015. Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Xi'an, China.
business_summary_ko: Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited는 중국에서 의료 서비스를 제공합니다. 병원과 의료센터를 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 보험 중개, 전자상거래, 건강 및 자산 관리, 관광, 전문 디자인, 기술 개발, 식품 및 음료, 의약품 생산 사업에도 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Xi'an Kaiyuan Investment Group Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2015년 1월에 Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited는 1986년에 설립되었으며 중국 시안(Xi'an)에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
